verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
It's a new day
Everything changed

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
When your love came into the darkness
You sent the light of the Son
You sent the light of the Son

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Wake up, open your eyes
No longer dead, We are alive

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Rise up, children of light
Open the doors, go let it shine

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
There is freedom
In your kingdom

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
For you Jesus we will be dancing
Forever your joy is our song
Forever your joy is our song

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Song for the broken, let it shine
Into the shadow, let it shine
Hope for the whole world, let it shine, let it shine
